about: Kaskade 4-week plan for Phase 2B: exact assignments for every block (follow-up #16) — real material first (ARD/ZDF Mediathek episodes fetched into the library, Easy German Podcast episodes, that day's nachrichtenleicht.de articles (#22; week 1 Tuesday was tagesschau, already read), YouTube via Language Reactor, books with notice); Kaskade's AI-written texts and practice tasks only as fallback, tagged. One material per block in day.materials (catalog: stock.json); prompts and week 6 come from weeks-1-4.json. #27: no exam block; the 60-min lesen block holds two exact items (text after audio, audio after text).
